OpenRouterAdapter — ProviderPort for OpenRouter.

API endpoint: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions Auth: Bearer token REQUIRED headers: HTTP-Referer and X-Title (platform policy).

Format: OpenAI-compatible (system as first message with role=system, messages array with role/content pairs).
